stories.title: Drug trade to be uprooted from country by end of 2029: Amit Shah

en.title: Drug trade to be uprooted from country by end of 2029: Amit Shah
en.summary: India's Union Home Minister stated that drug trafficking will be eliminated by 2029, calling for enforcement agencies to dismantle entire trafficking networks by investigating finances, digital evidence, and cartel profits.

en.summary: Karnataka's Assembly Deputy Speaker expressed concern that the Kasturirangan report may compel families in Uttara Kannada district to relocate to Goa.

stories.title: Trump touts Venezuela oil deal, says it will drive down energy prices worldwide

en.title: Trump touts Venezuela oil deal, says it will drive down energy prices worldwide
en.summary: President Trump announced a 65 billion-barrel oil agreement with Venezuela aimed at reducing global energy prices and increasing Venezuelan production, though experts question immediate price impacts due to infrastructure limitations.

stories.title: Girl gang-raped on her 17th birthday at a Delhi park, by three men posing as police personnel

en.title: Girl gang-raped on her 17th birthday at a Delhi park, by three men posing as police personnel
en.summary: Three men, including an advocate, student, and street vendor, were arrested after gang-raping a 17-year-old girl in a Delhi park by impersonating police and using weapons to isolate her from her friend.

stories.title: Karnataka HC orders court-monitored probe into KPSC irregularities; sets up SIT headed by DGP Alok Kumar

en.title: Karnataka HC orders court-monitored probe into KPSC irregularities; sets up SIT headed by DGP Alok Kumar
en.summary: Karnataka High Court established a Special Investigation Team headed by DGP Alok Kumar to investigate KPSC irregularities. The team has been given 100 days to complete its investigation and must submit progress reports every 30 days.

en.summary: Medical personnel provided continuous healthcare support during India's Asian Games hosting, managing emergency calls at all hours with substantial supplies of medicines and medical equipment.

en.summary: India's Home Minister Amit Shah announced a 2029 deadline for eliminating drug trafficking into the country while addressing national anti-narcotics officials in New Delhi.

en.title: Rajya Sabha polls for 12 seats: BJP likely to retain 8 in UP, SP eyes gain
en.summary: Rajya Sabha elections for 12 seats in Uttar Pradesh are expected to see the BJP maintaining eight seats while the Samajwadi Party pursues gains.

stories.title: Hindustan Copper shares gain 3% as company plans Rs 7,000 crore capital investment in next 5 years

en.title: Hindustan Copper shares gain 3% as company plans Rs 7,000 crore capital investment in next 5 years
en.summary: Hindustan Copper's shares rose following the company's announcement of a Rs 7,000 crore investment over 5-6 years. The company signed agreements with major state-owned enterprises to expand mining operations and partnered with Chile's CODELCO for expertise development.

stories.title: Embassy Developments rallies 8% after Rs 711 crore residential tower deal with Angel One founder

en.title: Embassy Developments rallies 8% after Rs 711 crore residential tower deal with Angel One founder
en.summary: Embassy Developments' stock rose after the company agreed to sell an entire residential tower at its Juhu property to Angel One's chairman for Rs 711 crore. The 63,000 sq ft transaction represents India's largest single residential property deal.

stories.title: Textile stocks rally up to 10%: Raymond, Gokaldas Exports & others rebound after Trump tariff-triggered selloff

en.title: Textile stocks rally up to 10%: Raymond, Gokaldas Exports & others rebound after Trump tariff-triggered selloff
en.summary: Indian textile stocks recovered on Tuesday from previous losses, with Raymond gaining 10% and other companies including Pearl Global Industries, Gokaldas Exports, Arvind and Vardhman Textiles also advancing. The rebound followed US President Trump signing a Russia sanctions bill.

stories.title: Pace Digitek shares jump 13% after subsidiary bags Rs 488 crore BESS order

en.title: Pace Digitek shares jump 13% after subsidiary bags Rs 488 crore BESS order
en.summary: Pace Digitek's share price surged after its subsidiary Lineage Power secured a Rs 488.46 crore battery energy storage order from NTPC GE Power Services. The project at a thermal power facility includes system containers, maintenance, and warranty coverage through December 2026.

stories.title: Waaree Energies shares gain 2% after company bags 2 GW solar module order

en.title: Waaree Energies shares gain 2% after company bags 2 GW solar module order
en.summary: Waaree Energies secured a 2 GW solar module supply order from a domestic solar developer for FY27-FY28, causing shares to rise 2%. The stock has declined recently despite the order and trades below most moving averages.
